name: Our Lady of the Assumption St Agnes and St John Fisher, Langley
shortName: Our Lady of the Assumption St Agnes and St John Fisher
note: We do not currently have the description of a boundary between Our Lady and St Agnes and St John Fisher.

boundary.description: From the crossing of Mills Hill – Castleton railway and M62 motorway, S along railway to the point where it crosses a river, near Scowcroft Farm. Then west by a bee-line to and along river Irk, Park Rd, Middleton Rd (A576), Manchester Old Rd. N by Parkfield Dr, to the NW corner of Leisure Park, and W by a beeline across golf club grounds to the junction of Heywood Old Rd and unnamed road near Virgin Active Lancashire (including all properties along Rowrah Cres), then by a beeline to M62 opposite Egypt Farm and E by M62 to the railway.

supplementaryNote.title: Boundary between Our Lady of the Assumption and St Agnes and St John Fisher
supplementaryNote.text: There is currently no information available about the boundary between these two parishes.
